prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a rustic loaf of bread being torn open by two hands. The focus is on the rough, textured crust and the soft, airy interior of the bread, with crumbs and fibers catching the warm, golden light. The hands are positioned on either side of the loaf, fingers gently pressing into the crust, emphasizing the tactile sensation of breaking fresh bread. The background is softly blurred, creating a shallow depth of field that draws all attention to the bread and hands. The color palette is dominated by earthy browns, warm beiges, and subtle golden highlights, evoking a sense of comfort and homeliness. The lighting is soft and directional, casting gentle shadows that enhance the texture and volume of the bread. The overall style is reminiscent of a food commercial or an artisanal bakery advertisement, with a focus on natural beauty, authenticity, and the sensory pleasure of fresh, homemade bread.
